establishedEntryEvidence.confidence: high static reconstruction; physical execution not validated
establishedEntryEvidence.behavior: Stock PA23-low launch path loads MSP from the application vector at 0x5000, sets VTOR to 0x5000, then calls the application reset vector.
establishedEntryEvidence.qualification: Audit24 original boot trace on frozen3.5 stops at main, without interrupt delivery; unchanged 3.6 startup source and actual reset/stack contract rechecked statically here. Ordinary-reset preconditions, inherited IRQ5, active-state and asynchronous transition limitations retained.

unknowns: Application thread frames require privileged thread mode, CONTROL=0 (MSP), PRIMASK=0 and no active exception on the ordinary reset path; audit24 establishes only finite original-instruction fixture execution, not physical entry or asynchronous handoff.

Boot preserves priorities and non-reset interrupt state, enables NVMCTRL IRQ5 while reset peripheral INTEN remains zero, and runs SysTick with TICKINT clear. App enables UART/SysTick without setting their priorities and sets EIC priority 1; arbitrary inherited pending/active state and vector-transition exception delivery remain unverified.
No physical stack high-water, stack guard/canary, ISR-duration or NVM timing measurement exists.
Bounds assume valid control flow, intact callback/configuration data and ARMv6-M execution; memory corruption, bootloader execution and failed exception stacking are outside the model.

compiledHandoff.model: Static emitted instruction/control-flow review; no exceptions executed or scheduled.
